tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ḍā ki'i snyan brgyud zab mo las: bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo'i las byang bsdus pa myur mgyogs glog phreng bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcom ldan 'das ma bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong pa can la phyag 'tshal lo: 1$0000250bdag 'dra rdo rje gro lod kyis: bdud 'dul drag mo'i las byang ni: bsdus pa lam khyer glog phreng bri: de yang 'di la don gsum ste: sngon 'gro rtsa ba'i rim pa: dngos gzhi las gzhung gi rim pa: rjes tshogs kyi rim pa'o: dang po la dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba: gnyis pa mtshams gcod pa: gsum pa mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa: bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba: lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gsal gdab pa: drug pa gzhal yas khang gsal ba: bdun pa gdan bskyed pa: brgyad pa lha bskyed pa: dgu pa spyan 'dren pa: bcu pa bzhugs su gsol ba: bcu gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba: bcu gnyis pa mchod pa'i rim pa: bcu gsum pa bstod pa'i rim pa:1$0000300 1$0000250bcu bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba: bco lnga pa bzlas pas bskul ba'o: tshogs kyi rim pa la: dang po tshogs sbyang ba: gnyis pa byin rlabs pa: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa: bzhi pa tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba: lnga pa bar pa bshags pa bya ba: drug pa tha ma bsgral las bya ba: bdun pa zhal du bstab pa: brgyad pa lhag ma bya ba: dgu pa chad mdo 'bul ba: bcu pa brtan ma mchod pa: bcu gcig pa gtor bro bya ba: bcu gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba: bcu gsum pa bkra shis bya ba: bcu bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba: bco lnga pa bsngo smon bya ba'i rim pa'o: las byang rtsa tho'i rim pa rdzogs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ghu h+ya: zab rgya: 1$0000300 de nas spyi don gnyis pa dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: rang nyid bdud 'dul drag mo'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gha gha ghā ta ya: log par blta ba'i bgegs tshogs nyon: bdag ni bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong: nga yis gnas 'dir byang chub bsgrub: bgegs tshogs gang yin phyir dengs shig: gal te bka' la mi nyan na: mkha' 'gro chen mo thugs khros nas: sku las me dpung mtshon cha 'phros:

gsung las drag sngags thog ser 'phros: thugs las khro chung mtshon thogs 'phros: gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs kun: 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon: rgya gram 'bar bas klad pa 'gems: phur bu'i dbal sos snying la gzir: ral gri 'bar bas gzugs phung gtub: me dpung 'bar bas gzhob tu bsreg: mtshon cha sna tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog: sems kyis sdug bsngal dpag med myong: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki kro tī shwa rī hūm̐: sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā gṛh+ṇā hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza kro ta ni hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: bdag ni dpal chen khrag 'thung ma: sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul las: ye shes mkha' 'gros nam mkha' gang: dam tshig mkha' 'gros sa gzhi gang: las kyi mkha' 'gros bar snang gang: me dpung 'bar bas srid gsum sreg: mtshon cha sna tshogs skar ltar 'khrug: su yang 'da' ba'i gnas med do: srung ba'i 'khor lo lhun gyis grub: hrīḥdhī ha ḍā ki kro ti siṃ ha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa ni: skyabs yul mdun du bsam la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ka dag rig pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi: ma rig 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba mtha' med 'dir: rigs drug gang gi gnas su lus blangs kyang: sdug bsngal min pa bde ba skad cig med: bde chen chos dbyings thob phyir dam chos bya: rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil na mdzes: khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu: skyabs gnas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum: dkon mchog gsum la bdag sogs skyabs su mchi: rnam rtog chos nyid ngang du ma grol zhing: 'gyur med chos sku'i rtogs pa ma shar bar: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thugs rje can: rtsa ba gsum la bdag sogs skyabs su mchi:

spros bral dmigs med bde chen thabs shes 'brel: sku lnga lhun grub ye shes lnga rdzogs shing: lta sgom spyod 'bras thig le lu gu rgyud: rang byung dbyings la bdag gzhan skyabs su mchi: zhes gsum bya: de nas sems bskyed pa ni: kye ma: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa'i nang: rang gis rang bcings chos med snying re rje: snying rje'i gnas rnams bde la bkod pa'i phyir: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi: zhes gsum brjod: de nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku 'gyur med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: sna tshogs thabs kyis cir yang sprul mdzad cing: 'gro rnams thar pa'i lam ston ma rgyud rnams: mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: bdag gis sgo gsum gus pa chen po yis: yan lag bdun ldan bsgrubs pa'i thabs shes rab: bde stong zag med rnam grol phyag rgya yis: bde chen la zla chen por phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor bshams dang yid kyis blangs pa yis: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho rnams: dpag med nam mkha'i khams rnams kun bkang ste: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: lus ngag yid gsum bag med dbang gyur pas: sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci bgyis pa: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: bla ma mkha' 'gros sngon nas thugs bskyed pa'i: dge ba kun la rjes su yi rang ngo: rdo rje slob dpon mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams: 'gro ba'i don du chos 'khor bskor du gsol: ma hā gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: bdag gzhan kun gyi tshogs gnyis dge ba 'dis: sems can thams cad smin grol 'god par shog: ces bya: de nas dam bca' blang ba ni: hūm̐: bdud 'dul drag mo yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro sde brgyad sprul par bcas: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub: mi 'bral dam tshig sa ma ya:

tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐: gsum pa mchod pa byin rlabs phyir byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub gsang chen dur khrod nas: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: bdag la dbang skur bsgrub rdzas byin chen phob: zag med bde ba chen por byin gyis rlobs: baṃ ḍā ki sarba sa ma ya ā be sha ya a a ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya shu kraṃ sarba bhu tsa ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hā: bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol: bdag gis thog ma med nas da lta'i bar: mi dge 'gal 'khrul nyams chag gyur pa kun: skad cig da lta'i dus 'dir bshags par bgyi: siṃ ha ḍā ki sa ma ya shud+dhe ho: lnga pa ting 'dzin gsal ba ni: hūm̐: ye nas chos rnams spros bral nyid: kun khyab nam mkha'i rang bzhin te: brjod du med pa'i don de nyid: ma rtogs sems can snying re rje: dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa ho: drug pa gzhal yas khang gsal ba ni: hūm̐: skye ba med pa'i cho 'phrul las: rang byung 'byung ba lnga rim brtsegs: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod rab tu 'bar: gsang chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang: 'od lnga thod pa brtsegs pa yi: sgo gru rta babs yongs su rdzogs: phyi nang med par 'od du 'bar: dur khrod chen po brgyad dang ni: mtshon cha me dpung 'bar bas bskor: bdun pa gdan bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: de dbus chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus: pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba la: thabs shes nyi ma zla ba dang: rtog med ro yi gdan steng du: brgyad pa lha gsal gdab pa ni:

hūm̐: rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ dmar nag: 'od 'phros tshur 'dus mkha' 'gro'i sku: dus gsum rgyal ba skyed byed ma: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong: sku mdog dmar nag khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig khrag ltar 'khrugs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs rkan sgra rdeb: snyan cha nyi zla phrag tu bkal: phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la phyar: phyag g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs 'gying: thabs kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: sku stod glang chen ko rlon gsol: sku smad stag gi sham thabs mdzes: zhing lpags rlon pa rked du dkris: rdo rje'i phreng bas sku regs bcings: dril chung g.yer kha si li li: dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan: lhag ma thur grol sgrub mchog skyong: skra gseb rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: spyi gtsug rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar: thod rlon khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i phreng: rus rgyan me long dril bus spras: dar sna'i cod pan sprin ltar bklubs: sku la me 'od tshwa tshwa 'phro: ye shes me 'bar dbus na 'gying: spyi bor gu ru pad+ma 'byung: rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams par bskyed: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng: gang 'dul sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub byed ma: hūm̐: mdun du rdo rje seng gdong ma: dkar mo zhi ba'i las mdzad ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: seng zhal khro zhing gar stabs 'gying: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo'i tshul: rang 'dra dkar mo 'bum gyis bskor: g.yas su rin chen seng gdong ma: ser mo rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: seng zhal khro zhing gar stabs 'gying: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo'i tshul: rang 'dra ser mo 'bum gyis bskor: rgyab tu pad+ma seng gdong ma: dmar mo dbang gi las mdzad ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: seng zhal khro zhing gar thabs 'gying: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo'i tshul:

rang 'dra dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor: g.yon du karma seng gdong ma: ljang mo drag po'i las mdzad ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: seng zhal khro zhing gar stabs 'gying: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo'i tshul: rang 'dra ljang mo 'bum gyis bskor: kun kyang pad+ma bam ro'i gdan: brkyang bskum bde ba'i gar gyis 'gying: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim pad 'dab brgyad: thugs sprul las kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad: shar du rdo rje phag gdong mthing: phyag gnyis cang te'u bum pa bsnams: lho ru mkha' 'gro stag gdong smug: phyag gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan+dha bsnams: nub tu mkha' 'gro chu srin dmar: phyag gnyis rgyal mtshan bhan+dha bsnams: byang du mkha' 'gro gzig gdong ljang: phyag gnyis zhing chen thod khrag bsnams: shar lhor mkha' 'gro khyi gdong dkar: phyag gnyis par bu thod khrag bsnams: lho nub mkha' 'gro khra gdong sngo: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: nub byang mkha' 'gro spyang gdong dkar: phyag gnyis bum pa thod khrag bsnams: byang shar mkha' 'gro 'ug gdong ser: phyag gnyis zhags pa thod khrag bsnams: kun kyang ro gdan gar stabs 'gying: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim 'khor yug tu: ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang: dbang phyug nyer brgyad dam can dang: dur khrod brgyad kyi lha tshogs bcas: bran g.yog 'khor bcas gsal bar bskyed: de yi phyi rim sgo bzhi la: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chu zla 'am: 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar bsgom: oṃ dz+nyā na siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya hūm̐ dza dza: dgu pa spyan 'dren pa ni: rang bzhin gyi gnas dang: o rgyan rang byung mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma la: 'khor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'bum dang bcas pa nam mkha' la sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu byin thib thib byon par bsam la: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥpheṃ pheṃ:

zhes pas tshil chen bsreg: thod rnga 'khrol la 'di skad bskul: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni o rgyan rang bzhin gnas: mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng gdong gshegs su gsol: shar phyogs mi 'gyur gsang chen dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs gter 'byung gsang chen dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro seng gdong gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs pad+ma 'khyil ba'i gsang chen nas: pad+ma mkha' 'gro seng gdong gshegs su gsol: byang phyogs kī la sgrog pa'i gsang chen nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong gshegs su gsol: phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: mkha' 'gro sde brgyad ma lus gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bka' 'khor du: dbang phyug nyer brgyad ma mo mkha' 'gro dang: shugs 'gro las byed bran g.yog pho nya rnams: dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs 'byon pa'i tshe: rin chen rus rgyan khra la la: g.yer kha rin chen dril chung ni: snyan pa'i sgra sgrog si li li: dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod pan rnams: rlung gis skyod cing pu ru ru: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: rkang pa rdo rje'i 'gros stabs kyis: mkha' la thogs med bun ne bun: mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thibs se thib: glu len bshugs pa kyu ru ru: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: byin rlabs ye shes ta la la: sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: phaṭaḥdang pheṃ sgra 'u ru ru: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: e ā ral+li pheṃ pheṃ hring hring siṃ ha kro tī sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bcu pa bzhugs gsol 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i gnas 'di ru: mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: chos 'byung pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du:

dgyes shing gnyis med brtan par bzhugs su gsol: siṃ ha ḍā ki nī sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bcu gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gang 'dul zil gnon bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad pa: dpal chen myur mgyogs lha mo 'khor bcas la: brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: siṃ ha ḍā ki nī a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: bcu gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: 'di la drug ste: dang po phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas la: dmar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sku la 'bul: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul: gsal ba'i snang gsal spyan la 'bul: bde ba'i byug chab sku la 'bul: bcud ldan zhal zas ljags la 'bul: sgra snyan rol mo snyan la 'bul: phyag rgya gar dang spyan gzigs tshogs: mchog gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐: ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ho: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza ho: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza ho: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza ho: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza ho: oṃ badz+ra nai bid+yā pū dza ho: oṃ badz+ra shab+da pū dza ho: gnyis pa nang mchod ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas la: dbang po'i me tog spyan la 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga snyan la 'bul: tshil chen bsreg spos shangs la 'bul: sha rus zhal zas ljags la 'bul: khrag zhag byug chab sku la 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: yid chos lta sgom mchod par bzhes: oṃ badz+ra rū pa pūṣ+pe ho: ka pā la shab+da pū dza ho: māṃ sa dhū pe pū dza ho: kiṃ ni ri ti ra sa pū dza ho: rak+ta go ro tsa na gan+dhe pū dza ho:

gsum pa gsang mchod ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang nas: gnyis med bde chen ye shes che: gsang mchod byang sems dkar dmar 'di: dngos grub stsol phyir mchod par 'bul: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ma hā gu h+ya shu kraṃ pū dza ho: bzhi pa bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas la: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: rigs lnga dam tshig rmad du byung ba yi: stong la sbyar ba'i dug lnga 'joms pa'i sman: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa badz+ra a mṛta pū dza la khā hi: lnga pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas la: gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rnam dag chos dbyings bhan+dha ru: ba liṃ gtor ma bshams pa ni: sha khrag dmar gyi longs spyod dang: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i ro mchog ldan: 'dod yon lha mo sprin ltar gtibs: ngo mtshar rmad byung gtor ma 'bul: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: drug pa rak+ta 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro seng gdong drag mo 'khor bcas la: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i zhal bu'i snod: khams gsum 'khor ba rgyu bsgral pa'i: rak+ta'i zhun chen rba klong 'khrugs: khrag zhag rlangs pa chi li li: 'o mtsho dkar mdangs me re re: rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong pa can: dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum mchog ma:

sku mdog dmar nag mi bzad rab tu 'bar: khro zhing gtum la snang srid zil gyis gnon: spyan gsum sdang mig 'khor 'das dbang du sdud: 'byung po 'dul phyir zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: rkan sgra rdeb pas srid gsum g.yo zhing 'dar: nyi zla phrag 'phyang srid gsum 'gran zla med: nyon mongs rtsad gcod phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams: ma rungs bcud bsdus thod khrag g.yon na bsnams: dregs pa bdud bzhi gnon pas brkyang bskum bzhugs: thabs shes dbyer med kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan du bcug: mi 'jigs stobs ldan glang chen ko rlon gsol: chos nyid rol pa stag gi sham thabs byed: nyon mongs mi mnga' zhing lpags rked du dkris: chos nyid 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku regs bcings: sku lnga yongs rdzogs dbu skra thod skam bcings: rig pa thogs med rdo rje rtse lngas brgyan: lhag ma thur grol sgrub mchog rjes su skyong: skra gseb rdo rje rtse lnga'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: 'khor ba gnas 'dren thod rlon phreng bas brgyan: sku gsum yongs rdzogs rin chen rus rgyan spras: chos nyid rang sgra me long dril bu sgrog: ye shes lnga ldan dar sna'i cod pan bklubs: 'byung po gzhob sreg sku las me dpung 'bar: zhal nas phaṭaḥdang pheṃ gyi sngags sgra sgrog: sa gsum bla 'phrog seng skad rngam par sgrog: spyan gsum khro gnyer pho rgyud mo rgyud sdud: che btsan 'gran zla med pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: bdud 'dul seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgrub pa po la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro rnam pa bzhi: zhi ba'i las byed rdo rje seng gdong ma: dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod bsnams: rin chen rus brgyan brkyang bskum gar stabs 'gying: zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar mo 'bum dang bcas: rdo rje seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje chos kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rin chen seng gdong ma:

ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: rin chen rus brgyan brkyang bskum gar stabs 'gying: rgyas pa'i las byed ser mo 'bum dang bcas: rin chen seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe dang bsod nams dngos grub bdag la stsol: hūm̐: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma seng gdong ma: dmar mo zhi 'dzum phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: rin chen rus rgyan mdangs ldan gar stabs 'gying: dbang gi las byed dmar mo 'bum dang bcas: pad+ma seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub bdag la stsol: hūm̐: drag po'i las mdzad las kyi seng gdong ma: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: rin chen rus rgyan drag po'i gar stabs 'gying: drag po'i las byed ljang mo 'bum dang bcas: karma seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dngos grub bdag la stsol: hūm̐: gsung las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad: ye shes grub kyang las kyi cha lugs 'dzin: dam tshig srung zhing sgrub la stongs grogs mdzad: bstan pa srung zhing gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral: phra men las byed tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las sna tshogs dngos grub bdag la stsol: hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i las byed ma mo'i tshogs: zhing skyong dbang phyug nyer brgyad dam can rnams: dur khrod nyul cing bka' yi bya ra byed: sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges cir yang ston: 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med 'gro: phrin las sna tshogs thogs pa med par sgrub: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bcu bzhi pa bshags pa bya zhing gsol ba btab pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bka' nyan bcas: ma lus bdag gis gsol 'debs dgongs par mdzod: bdag ni ma rig mi dge 'gal 'khrul kun: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bshags par bgyi:

bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dang smon lam btab: da dus dkyil 'khor 'di ru bsnyen cing sgrub: 'di nas bzung ste gdod ma chos sku'i bar: tshe rabs skye ba gang dang gar skyes kyang: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dang 'bral med shog: bar chad rkyen rnams khyed kyis bsal ba dang: ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung bar shog: bran ltar nyan cing mdza' ltar brtse ba dang: theg chen chos la rtag tu gnas par shog: ting 'dzin zas kyis rtag tu 'tsho byed cing: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par shog: ḍā ki nī sa ma ya shud+dhe a: bco lnga pa dzap bzla ba ni: gtso mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: baṃ yig dmar po la sngags g.yon skor du dmar hril le 'khor bar bsam la bsnyen pa bya ba ni: oṃ baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐ dza: zhes bsnyen pa bya: de nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig tu dril ba'i drag sngags bcu bzhi pa bzlas pa bya ba ni: gtso mo'i thugs srog la hūm̐ dmar nag gi mtha' mar sngags phreng dkar ser dmar ljang las bzhi gang byed kyis mdog dang mthun par gsal la: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: ces a gcig: ka gcig: sa gnyis: ma gnyis: ra gsum: tsa gcig: sha gcig: da gcig: ya gcig: phaṭaḥbacas yod: zhi drag gang yin kyang dmigs pa sogs gzhan du shes: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs bya ba ni: dang po tshogs sbyang ba ni bsang chu 'thor la 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ 'phros tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ 'phros bag chags dri ma gtor: khaṃ 'phros gnyis 'dzin dri ma bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: bdud rtsi 'thor la 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: hūm̐ 'phros bdag gzhan 'bag btsog dag: āḥ'aphros zag med bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ 'phros 'dod yon mkha' mnyam spel:

lha mi'i longs spyod bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum brjod: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni: rkang gling thod rnga rdung rol mo bya la 'di skad do: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni o rgyan gnas: dur khrod ming ni gsang chen bsnol: mkha' spyod bde ba chen po nas: ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: seng gdong rigs bzhi yang 'khor bcas: sprul pa bka' nyan 'khor bcas rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sku mdog dmar mo bzhin mdzes ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi mdangs 'bar: phyag g.yas gcod byed gri gug bsnams: 'khor ba'i bcud bsdus thod khrag g.yon: sku la rin chen rgyan drug spras: sku regs gser skud dril chung brgyan: snyan pa'i sgra sgrog si li li: dbu rgyan dar sna'i cod pan can: rlung gis skyod cing pu ru ru: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar byed khyugs se khyug: rkang pa rdo rje'i 'gros stabs kyis: mkha' la thogs med bun ne bun: 'khor tshogs mkha' 'gro spungs se spung: glu len bshugs pa kyu ru ru: rol mo sil snyan 'u ru ru: byin rlabs ye shes ta la la: nyams dang rtogs pa 'u ru ru: bde stong ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ha ri ni sa'i sgra sgrog cing: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru phyin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang skur cig: bsgrub rdzas tshogs la sid+dhi stims: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ho: sa ma ya ho: dṛ sh+ya hoḥs ma ya dza dza: e ā ral+li hoḥpheṃ pheṃ hring hring dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: zhe rgyas par 'dod na las byang chen mo'i skabs ltar bya: bzhi pa tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul seng gdong 'khor bcas la: zhal zas mchog gi tshogs mchod dang: shes rab ma ti dza gad chang: thabs mchog māṃ sa bca' ba'i ro: brtse ba chen pos bzhes su gsol:

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: baṃ siṃ ha ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: lnga pa bar ma 'bul zhing bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs dgongs: bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar: rang rig ma rtogs nyams chag rnams: sman mchod tshogs kyis bshags par bgyi: ḍā ki nī sa ma ya shud+dhe a a: drug pa tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni bdud 'dul seng gdong ma: phyag mtshan phur pa bsgril cing 'debs: sku stod khro mo rngams shing brjid: sku smad gnam lcags dbal zur gsum: sreg cing ngar dang ldan pa 'di: dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du gzir: ḍā ki kro tī kī la ya che ge nṛ tri sha tūṃ mā ra ya rbad: bdun pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong lha tshogs rnams: chos nyid mi 'gyur gsal ba'i zhal phyes shig: nyon mongs dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: chos dbyings skye med gru gsum zhal du stobs: nyon mongs dgra bgegs chos kyi dbyings su rol: ḍā ki siṃ ha mu kha che ge'i sha khrag rus gsum la kha raṃ khā hi: brgyad pa lhag ma bya ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong: bka' 'khor pho nya phud lhag dbang ba rnams: 'dir byon pha 'bab lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes: sgrub pa po yi bar chad rkyen ngan zlog: bh+yo: zhing skyong dam can las byed tshogs: dam tshig can gyi srung ma yin: dam nyams rnams kyi srog gcod yin: legs nyes gnyis kyi stangs gcod mdzod: dam tshig srung zhing stong gsum nyul: sgrub pa'i drod nyul tshogs khang 'grim: rdzu 'phrul thogs med mkha' la 'phyo: bran dang yang g.yog bsam mi khyab: zhal zas phud lhag 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag la stongs grogs mdzod: phrin las thogs med sgrub pa dang: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zlog: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa kha kha khā hi khā hi:

dgu pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: lha gnas gsum dang dur khrod brgya rtsa ru: dpal chen che mchog pad+ma he ru kas: snang srid ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus: gsang sngags sbyor sgrol mdzad nas dam la btags: dam tshig bka' yi chad mdo bsgrags pa dang: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma sbyin byas nas: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: dam tshig bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: de 'og rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: mu stegs bdud kyi ston pa byung ba'i tshe: ston pa'i rgyal tshab pad+ma thod phreng gis: dur khrod chen po gsang chen rol du byon: mkha' 'gro phra men dbang du sdud pa dang: tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas mchod pa'i tshe: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma mo phra men dang: dur khrod gnas pa'i lha srin ma lus kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas ni: mu stegs bdud dpung btul bar ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: bstan dgra'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og kha ba can gyi bod yul du: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chu 'go tshugs pa'i dus: mchims phu la sogs gsang ba'i sgrub gnas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma sna nam nam mkha'i snying po dang: jo mo mtsho rgyal bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro mas: yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: zhing skyong mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: bstan dgra'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam:

dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gsang sngags theg chen bstan pa skyong ba dang: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi bar chad zlog: phyi log mu stegs mtha' yi dmag dpung zlog: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: pra mo hā i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma khyed rnams kyang: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs srog snying phul nas su: dam tshig can gyi bstan pa srung ba dang: sgrub pa po yi stongs grogs byed pa dang: rig 'dzin sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes: de ltar khas blangs dam bcas de bzhin du: brtan ma bcu gnyis dpon g.yog 'khor bcas rnams: dpal chen bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang: bsam pa'i 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang: dus 'khrugs mtha' dmag mi mthun zhi ba dang: ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma mā la lā ting ting hriṃ hriṃ sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu gcig pa gtor bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: ma mo rnams kyi pho brang 'dir: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: ye shes mkha' 'gros nam mkha' gang: dam tshig mkha' 'gros bar snang gang: las byed mkha' 'gros sa gzhi gang: sna tshogs mkha' 'gros phyogs mtshams gang: hūm̐: bro ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bro: me long ye shes ngang du brdung: zhe sdang dgra bgegs rang sar dag: ha ha shiṃn+ta ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: bro ni rin chen mkha' 'gro'i bro: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang du brdung: nga rgyal dgra bgegs rang sar dag: ri ri puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: bro ni pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i bro: sor rtog ye shes ngang du brdung: 'dod chags dgra bgegs rang sar dag: ni ni pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: bro ni las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bro:
bya grub ye shes ngang du brdung: phrag dog dgra bgegs rang sar dag: sa sa mā ra ya phaṭa: dgra bgegs s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: oṃ laṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: suṃ laṃ: nā sha ya nan:

bcu gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: ma gcig seng gdong dngos grub kun gyi mdzod: bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod dang du blangs pa yis: sku yi byin rlabs tshe bcud lus la stsol: gsung gi byin rlabs sngags kyi dngos grub stsol: thugs kyi byin rlabs ting 'dzin dngos grub stsol: yon tan byin rlabs bsod nams dngos grub stsol: phrin las byin rlabs 'jigs brgyad zhi gyur cig: thun mong yid bzhin bsam 'grub dngos grub stsol: 'khor 'das snang srid dbang sdud dngos grub stsol: steng gi lha yi longs spyod dngos grub stsol: bar gyi mi yi mnga' thang dngos grub stsol: 'og phyogs klu yi longs spyod dngos grub stsol: rin chen sna lnga rgyal srid dngos grub stsol: bkra shis rtags brgyad snyan grags dngos grub stsol: snyan grags stong khams khyab pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'dod khams yid 'ong rdzas kyi dngos grub stsol: mthu rtsal drag po sgrol byed dngos grub stsol: phrin las sna tshogs thogs med dngos grub stsol: bkra shis las mtha' btsan pa'i dngos grub stsol: dbang thang rigs rgyud gsal ba'i dngos grub stsol: bstan pa'i srog shing tshugs pa'i dngos grub stsol: bla med phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: dus las ma 'da' dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ kā ya: āḥwā ka: hūm̐ tsit+ta: hrīḥbaṃ sarba sid+dhi sid+dhi pha la ho: bcu gsum pa bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: o rgyan pad+ma byin rlabs ye shes mdzod: dbang bzhis rgyud bzhi smin grol bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dngos grub rnam gnyis mdzod: zag med mchog la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: rdo rje seng gdong 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i lha: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: rin chen seng gdong bsod nams rgyas pa'i lha: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog:

pad+ma seng gdong dbang sdud mdzad pa'i lha: dbang gi phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: karma seng gdong mngon spyod drag po'i lha: drag po'i phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro bka' nyan dam can tshogs: bstan pa mi nub skyong ba'i phrin las lha: bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog: bcu bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: 1$0000250dam tshig pa rang gi thugs kar bstim: ye shes kyi ḍā ki rten la bstim: 1$0000300 shis pa brjod: rten med na dbyings su gshegs te: ā+oṃ bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: de ring nyid du gshegs nas kyang: thugs rjes sems can don slad du: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra mu: sarba gats+tsha: zhes dkyil 'khor mtha' nas dbus su bsdu: dbus gtso bo rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur nas: bdag gi spyi bo nas lus la rdo rje'i go bgos nas srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsam: bco lnga pa bsngo ba smon lam bya ba ni: e ma ho: gsang sngags bla med mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: ma rig 'gal 'khrul cho ga lhag chad dang: ma dag bklags dang mchod rdzas ma tshang nyams: ma dad la sogs nongs gyur bzod par gsol: deng nas bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro dang: skye dang tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med cing: sa bcu lam lnga 'phags pa'i yon tan rdzogs: stong nyid mngon gyur sangs rgyas ma thob bar: ma ltar byams pas skyong zhing sring ltar gdung: grogs ltar 'grogs nas bran ltar las byed cing: byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad kun sel nas: bdud 'dul stong nyid phyag rgya chen por grol: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin mya ngan 'das gyur cig: bdag la mos pa'i ma 'ongs rjes 'jug rnams: phrin las sna tshogs gang dang gang bsgrub kyang: bar chad med par myur du 'grub gyur nas: sgrub pa po yis las bzhi lhun grub shog: ces rgyas pa las byang chen mo'i gzhung ltar bya'o:

rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ḍā ki sku rgya: ḍā ki gsung rgya: ḍā ki thugs rgya: brda thim: zab rgya: gu rgya: la bhi: stag stag bra tham: bdag stag sham nus ldan pas gter nas gdan drangs shing sa yos lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la shog ser nas bshus so// maṅga laṃ/// /
